description: IT Team with extreme guardrails - tests Guardrails v5 confidence scoring (expect 0.8-0.95 scores)
HAUPTLEISTUNG: Custom software development, DevOps consulting, and cloud infrastructure management for enterprise clients with strict security and compliance requirements.

answers.hauptleistung: Custom software development, DevOps consulting, and cloud infrastructure management for enterprise clients with strict security and compliance requirements.
answers.ki_guardrails: Under no circumstances may AI systems deploy code to production, modify infrastructure, access secrets, or interact with customer data without explicit human approval. No autonomous remediation. No access to repositories via external LLMs. Customer data must never be processed by AI tools. No AI-generated code in security-critical modules without manual review. Do not automate incident response. Personnel decisions are off-limits. No AI communication with clients without oversight. Confidential project information must not be shared with any AI service.
answers.ki_projekte: Stabilize CI/CD pipelines with AI-assisted code review, implement intelligent log analysis, develop AI-powered documentation generators with strict output validation, and create automated test case generation with mandatory human approval.
answers.zeitersparnis_prioritaet: Code reviews, documentation updates, test writing, and incident analysis consume significant developer time. However, all AI assistance must maintain strict human oversight.
answers.geschaeftsmodell_evolution: Develop AI-augmented development workflows that maintain security and compliance while improving efficiency, targeting enterprise clients with strict regulatory requirements.
answers.vision_3_jahre: Become an AI-first development organization while maintaining the highest security and compliance standards. All AI integrations must preserve human control and audit trails.
answers.strategische_ziele: Reduce review cycle times by 40% with AI assistance, maintain 100% compliance with security policies, achieve zero unauthorized AI deployments, and establish industry-leading AI governance practices.
